name: c64
title: Commodore 64
description: Frodo C64 emulator rebuilt as a current ESPHomeBrew PAX.
author: Frodo; P4 port by RetroESP32-P4
about: Runs Commodore 64 D64 and T64 disk images from the SD card. Place the C64 ROM images in /sd/roms/c64/bios/.
changelog: 0.1.4: Rebuilt the PAPP2 compatibility host to expose the current PAX service table.
controls: Default D-pad: C64 joystick ports 1 and 2, plus WASD
Default A/B: joystick fire and Space
Swipe-down menu > Button Mapper: edit controls

requires.note: Optional disk; BASIC can run without a disk
Optional disk; BASIC can run without a disk

extract.instructions:
Provide the complete matching data set from your original installation or the verified download choice below. Keep filenames and subfolders as listed.

FILES / FOLDERS

/sd/roms/c64/bios/basic.rom — 8 KiB BASIC ROM

/sd/roms/c64/bios/kernal.rom — 8 KiB KERNAL ROM

/sd/roms/c64/bios/char.rom — 4 KiB character ROM

/sd/roms/c64/bios/1541.rom — 16 KiB drive ROM

/sd/roms/c64/*.d64 — Optional disk; BASIC can run without a disk

development_note: Current-source PAPP2 build uses a 13/8 exact P4 PPA display scale to keep C64 rendering close to the 50 Hz audio cadence; AIO runtime verified.
